messages:
morgan_sec: Heads-up: we've got a penetration test scheduled next Wednesday (03/11). Assessor: AcmeRedTeam. Need to lock scope + telemetry plan by EOD Monday.

sam_infra: 👍 can you drop the exact asset list? need to map to ephemeral roles and KMS access.

morgan_sec: Uploaded initial scope CSV to s3://redwood-pt-scope/2026-03-acme-scope.csv. Short list in-thread: 3 kube namespaces (staging, canary, prod-readonly), public inference API endpoints, inference-hosting cluster rg-infer-1. No DB creds, no customer PII.

lee_sre: For RBAC, propose creating an ephemeral role `pt/acme-assessor` with 4h TTL scoped to read-only logs + Prometheus read. Plan to revoke after window. Any objections?

anya_ml: For model stores: assessors only need metadata views. No model weights or decrypt. We should ensure KMS never gives Decrypt to assessor role.

sam_infra: KMS detail: we'll front KMS decrypt through a secure proxy service. Assessors get presigned, short-lived URLs for objects. Draft policy snippet: 
```
{
  "Role": "pt-assessor",
  "Actions": ["s3:GetObject","logs:Describe*","logs:GetLogEvents","monitoring:ListMetrics"],
  "TTL": 14400
}
```

morgan_sec: That looks good. I'll tag tokens with `pt:acme` for easy filtering. @sam_infra can you add an audit sink to push all assessor actions to the `pt-audit` index (immutable)? We need an unmodifiable trail for the report.

sam_infra: On it. I'll create `pt-audit` alias, set retention 365d, and wire an audit-hook that writes events with event.source=pt-assessor. KMS key policy: Decrypt only for redwood-kms-admins; assessors only allowed kms:Encrypt via proxy.

pt_assessor_bot: Intake instruction: upload artifacts to https://uploads.redwood.company/pt/1776543211 using filename pattern `acme_<resource>_<ts>.zip`. Attach manifest.json with sha256 checksums.

lee_sre: Quick retest checklist (to include in runbook): snapshot logs (sha256), revoke `pt/acme-assessor` role at window end, rotate any ephemeral certs, run smoke inference calls against canary with sampling to ensure no degradations. Confirm prom metrics retention covers test period + 48h.

anya_ml: I'll prepare a small evaluation prompt set to run before/after the test to catch regressions (5 prompts, deterministic seeds). Will post results format.

morgan_sec: Action items summary: sam - create role + KMS proxy + audit sink; lee - revoke/rotate runbook + log snapshot steps; anya - eval set + post-test run. I'll coordinate presigned URL and share with AcmeRedTeam. Please ack in-thread.

sam_infra: ack

lee_sre: ack

anya_ml: ack

morgan_sec: One more: if Acme asks to expand scope during the window, route request to #eng-security and tag me + @oncall. No ad-hoc approvals in DM. :lock:
